messages:
Rachael (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount and short hiring pause. i'm leaving this thread open for clarifying q's.
Anya (People Ops): to confirm: freeze is scoped to non-customer-facing net-new roles for the next 3 weeks. backfills + critical infra and Dedicated/Private launch roles proceed.
Jules (CTO): we'll group specialized infra hires into a small Serving Core to speed calibration and reuse interviewers. this is a hiring routing change, not a reorg.
Leah (Eng Manager): will teams lose hiring autonomy? worried about delays.
Marco (Recruiter): autonomy largely intact. specialized roles route through a short shared loop; standard roles keep existing loops. aim: <1 week extra latency.
Anya (People Ops): uploading greenlist and process doc now: https://drive.redwood.example/hiring/greenlist-march. managers, add urgencies there.
Leah (Eng Manager): thanks. contractor conversions ok?
Anya (People Ops): conversions that replace headcount or are tied to launches ok. net-new conversions reviewed case-by-case. DM me for exceptions.
OpsBot: All-hands recording + slides: https://meetings.redwood.example/allhands-2026-03-23
Rachael (CEO): short recap: scoped pause, priority to customer-impacting infra & Dedicated/Private roles, Serving Core for scarce skills, greenlist + sync tomorrow 10am PT. dm Anya for private concerns. :white_check_mark:
